title: Welcome to Double Digits, Artist! 🎉
content: Hey Manu! You're 10 now! I'm writing this when you're little — you're currently obsessed with drawing butterflies and rainbows. Your art makes everyone smile. I hope you never stop creating. Keep painting the world beautiful! ❤️

title: You're a Teenager Now! 😱
content: Dear Manu, if you're reading this, you're probably a teenager with amazing art skills! When I wrote this, you were little and thought the best thing in the world was mixing colors to make new ones. I hope you're still creating beautiful things! ❤️

title: An Adult Artist! (Officially 😅)
content: Hey Manu, 18! Wow. When I wrote this, you were drawing butterflies on every piece of paper you could find. I wonder what you're creating now — maybe incredible paintings, digital art, or something we can't even imagine yet! This blog has all your childhood art saved forever. Love always ❤️

title: The World is Your Canvas, Manu! 🌍
content: Dear Manu, you're 21. This art blog started when you were little, showcasing your very first drawings. Back then, your biggest worry was whether to use pink or purple. Now you've got the whole world as your canvas. Whatever you create, wherever you go — know that your art has always been magical. ❤️
